UXUC80A is a medical procedure code from the Danish National Patient Register (Landspatientregisteret) that designates transthoracic stress echocardiography [^src1]. In the context of the national clinical quality guidelines for atrial fibrillation in Denmark, managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), this code is utilized to track and measure diagnostic compliance [^src1]. 

Specifically, UXUC80A is one of the designated codes that qualifies as a performed [[ekkokardiografi|Ekkokardiografi]] under Indicator 2 of the national quality metrics [^src1]. When calculating the numerator for this indicator, any patient registered with the UXUC80A code is counted as having received the required echocardiographic evaluation, ensuring accurate quality reporting for atrial fibrillation diagnostics [^src1].
